_comment: Hand labels for the held-out set, written 2026-10-17 by reading each snapshot BEFORE running the extractor on it. The extraction rules were not tuned on these pages; changes made after scoring them must be reported as tuned results. Conventions: a field absent from 'fields' is not scored; "not_stated" means the page does not establish it, so any extracted value is an unsupported claim; lists of accepted values cover pages that state several level- or region-dependent values; 'evidence' is a verbatim span from the page; deadline 'status' is relative to 2026-10-17.

evidence.levels: study for a one-year master’s degree at a UK university
